summary: One focused behavior within the leaf limits: land the tier-3 predator/territorial organisms (the 4-6 species WI-03c1 defines) into the production world, present and readable - production spawns in src/world/worldData.ts on the section 39 difficulty bands with the section 34 caps and section 49 dense traversal (debug-only ids per section 33, never in normal UI), plus the tier's new data-driven predator body shapes and pre-contact telegraph/commit visibility as shape parameters on the existing WI-02b renderer pipeline (section 13 two-second silhouette, section 48 visible commitment before contact). The spawn-data facet (world content data) and the rendering facet (procedural creature rendering) are two verification angles on this single observable outcome, not two independently shippable features: the creatures are invisible without their shapes and unrenderable without their spawns, and the headless tier-3 world-data check plus the single presentation-only browser spot-check are complementary evidence for the same behavior, not separate behaviors (the spot-check is evidence, per the skill's 'evidence for the same behavior does not create additional behaviors'). Changed subsystems are exactly two concrete owners, under the three-leaf cap. Boundaries are clean and non-overlapping: no creature definitions, per-predator controllers, non-chase strategy, damage model, or headless signature-rule tests (WI-03c1a/WI-03c1b), no simulation rule changes (any behavior defect found by the spot-check goes through the existing fix-planning route, not here), no large/colossal staging (WI-03d), no authored beat triggers (ST-04). AC-roster-count and AC-roster-tests are retained verbatim from WI-03c; this leaf owns the tier-3 portion of each (ids resolve and spawns sit in the designed band; spoiler containment of its own spawn/render artifacts, with the browser spot-check as its presentation proof), while the roster-wide count/test/audit checks finalize in WI-03d - so the union with WI-03c1's AC-roster-behavior and AC-roster-tests covers all three parent criteria. depends_on: [WI-03c1] is correct: WI-03c1 has been promoted to story ST-WI-03c1, so per the 'existing dependencies mean all its leaves' rule it binds both leaves WI-03c1a (the definitions the spawns reference) and WI-03c1b (the controllers the browser spot-check exercises), exactly as documented in the ST-WI-03c1 plan; it inherits WI-03b through the WI-03c story and must not start before WI-02a/b/c are accepted. Verification is focused tier-3 evidence (world-data band check, tier-3 spoiler containment, one representative browser spot-check with no console errors). The fresh-session handoff (WI-03c/plan.md, numbered request sections 13/33/34/39/48/49/68/70/74, WI-01b for selected ids and band placement, WI-03c1 for the landed ids, design_private/ as source of truth) lets a fresh implementer proceed without reconstructing the project. Matches the leaf shape the parent WI-03c split receipt prescribed.
